## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when available.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any platform or integration limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Unrelated application settings and recovery behavior are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests and generated assets are updated.
- [ ] User-facing strings are updated in every language catalog, if changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private profiles, account evidence, or build outputs are included.
- [ ] Documentation describes verified behavior and third-party attribution is preserved.
